historical_significance: 李靖（571—649），字药师，雍州三原人，唐初军神，封卫国公，凌烟阁二十四功臣之一。他早年仕隋，后归唐，南平萧铣、辅公祏，奠定唐朝对江南的统治；贞观三年（629）以定襄道行军总管统六路大军北伐东突厥，贞观四年正月率三千骁骑夜袭定襄，随后阴山之战大破颉利可汗，一举灭东突厥，俘颉利，唐太宗因此被尊为天可汗。贞观八、九年又统军西征吐谷浑，穿越积石山无人之境，追击两千里，伏允自缢，吐谷浑归附。晚年阖门自守，杜绝宾客，著有李卫公兵法（佚）与传世兵书唐太宗李卫公问对，系统阐发奇正相变、致人而不致于人的兵学思想，后世列入武经七书。贞观二十三年（649）病逝，年七十九，陪葬昭陵，谥景武。
historical_significance_en: Li Jing (571-649), courtesy name Yaoshi, born in Sanyuan, Yongzhou, was the foremost general of the early Tang dynasty, enfeoffed as Duke of Wei and one of the Twenty-Four Meritorious Officials of Lingyan Pavilion. He served the Sui before joining the Tang; he pacified Xiao Xian and Fu Gongshi in the south, securing Jiangnan for the new dynasty. In 629-630, as Field Commander of Dingxiang Route leading six armies, he raided Dingxiang at night with 3,000 elite cavalry and then crushed Illig Qaghan at Yinshan, annihilating the Eastern Turkic Khaganate, after which Emperor Taizong was honored as Heavenly Qaghan by steppe peoples. In 635 he led the western campaign against Tuyuhun, crossing the uninhabited Jishi Mountains and pursuing the enemy 2,000 li until Murong Fuyun hanged himself. In late life he kept his gates closed and declined visitors. His lost Duke of Wei's Art of War and the surviving Tang Taizong and Duke of Wei in Dialogue (one of the Seven Military Classics) systematically expound the interplay of orthodox and unorthodox (qi-zheng) and the principle of moving the enemy, not being moved. He died in 649 at 79, buried near Zhaoling, posthumous title Jingwu.

cross_references.relation_type: 君臣问对：兵学理论的整理者与实践者
cross_references.description_zh: 唐太宗李卫公问对以李世民与李靖问答形式传世：太宗历数战阵得失求证于李靖，李靖以奇正、虚实、分合之变作答。李世民是战略决策者与亲征实践者，李靖是独立统帅与兵学理论集大成者，二人共同塑造了唐初军事思想的巅峰。
cross_references.description_en: The Tang Taizong and Duke of Wei in Dialogue survives as a question-answer record between Li Shimin and Li Jing: the Emperor probes battlefield judgments, and Li Jing answers with the transformations of orthodox/unorthodox, void/substance, and division/union. Taizong was the strategic decision-maker and campaigning sovereign; Li Jing the independent commander and great systematizer of military theory. Together they defined the peak of early Tang military thought.

cross_references.relation_type: 跨代骑兵远征传统：汉之卫青与唐之李靖
cross_references.description_zh: 卫青与李靖分别是汉唐对草原决战胜利的代表统帅：卫青七击匈奴、直捣龙城，稳扎稳打；李靖雪夜下阴山、一役灭国，更强调奇袭与庙算。李卫公问对中屡引汉匈战例，唐代骑兵远程奔袭传统可上溯至卫霍。
cross_references.description_en: Wei Qing and Li Jing were the representative commanders of the Han and Tang decisive victories over the steppe: Wei Qing's seven campaigns against the Xiongnu proceeded by steady power projection; Li Jing's snow-night descent on Yinshan annihilated a khanate in one stroke through surprise and staff planning. The Dialogue repeatedly cites Han-Xiongnu campaigns, and the Tang tradition of long-range cavalry raids traces back to Wei and Huo.
